svg.aria-label: An AI client and the SealGate cloud gateway are separate servers on the public internet. The gateway drives a SealGate stdiod daemon on the user's machine over one outbound WebSocket that the daemon dials out. The daemon runs Beeper, a local stdio MCP server that bridges chat networks — WhatsApp, Telegram, X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Messenger, Discord, Slack — whose logins stay on the device. SealGate is a security gateway that checks every tool call against policy and blocks private data from leaking out.
